post.description: Creates a new project in ProjectManager.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

description.description: An optional description of the Project

shortId.description:
Specify the shortId for this project. If left blank a shortId will be generated.
            
A short identifier that uniquely identifies this Project within your Workspace
using a single letter followed by a number.  This code can be used for APIs
that accept Project unique identifiers.
            
You can observe the short ID within the application by observing the URL of
the page you visit when you click on this project.  The page's URL will appear
in the form `https://pm.app.projectmanager.com/project/board/D16` - in this
example, the `ShortId` is `D16`.
            
This id can only be set on creation, and can not be updated.

shortName.description: An optional project short name. Up to 7 symbols

folderId.description: The unique identifier of the folder of this project, or null if not assigned.

projectAccess.everyone.description: If set to true every user will get access to this project

projectAccess.members[].description: If everyone is set to false the list of members will be used to give people access

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer for this project, or null if not customer specific

managerId.description: The unique identifier of the manager of this project, or null if not assigned.

chargeCodeId.description: The unique identifier of the ChargeCode for this Project, if one has been selected.

statusId.description: The ProjectStatus chosen for this Project, if one has been selected.

priorityId.description: The ProjectPriority level of this Project, if one has been selected.

hourlyRate.description:
The default hourly rate for work on this Project.  This rate will be used
if an assignee working on this Project does not have an hourly rate configured
in their profile.

budget.description: The proposed budget for this Project.

statusUpdate.description:
Contains an optional status update for Projects that can be used to summarize
the status of multiple Projects at a glance.
            
You can edit the StatusUpdate field on the Portfolio page of the application.

templateId.description:
When creating a Project, you can optionally specify a Template to use to construct
the Project using a collection of pre-designed Tasks.
            
Specifying a value in the TemplateId field will copy default settings for Tasks from
your template Project into the newly created Project.
            
This field does not support custom templates.  You must choose from a list of
ProjectManager-supplied templates.

template.description: True if this Project is a Template project. Template projects can be used as

targetDate.description:
The target planned completion date for this Project, or null if one has
not been selected.  This value can be updated in the Project Settings
page or the Portfolio Project page within the application.

favorite.description: True if this Project is marked as favorite for current user

updatePlannedWithActual.description: True if allow actual dates to update planned dates

workingDays.monday.description: Set this value to true if Monday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.tuesday.description: Set this value to true if Tuesday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.wednesday.description: Set this value to true if Wednesday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.thursday.description: Set this value to true if Thursday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.friday.description: Set this value to true if Friday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.saturday.description: Set this value to true if Saturday is considered a working day for this project.

workingDays.sunday.description: Set this value to true if Sunday is considered a working day for this project.

externalReferenceId.description:
An optional external reference identifier for this Project.
This value can be used to link the Project to records in external systems,
such as ERP, CRM, or other integrations.

weekStartsOnMonday.description:
Controls which day is considered the first day of the week for this project.
If not specified, this will be Sunday in the US and Monday everywhere else.
If true, the week starts on Monday. If false, the week starts on Sunday.

post.description: Creates a new task in ProjectManager.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the Project that will contain this Task

name.description: The common name of this Task.

description.description: A description of the work to be performed in this Task.

percentComplete.description:
The numerical percentage, from 0-100, representing the percentage completion
for this Task.  Any numbers below zero or above 100 will be clamped to the
minimum or maximum value.
            
This value can be edited manually in the Gantt chart view of the application,
or can be selected on the Task Detail page within the Kanban board.

statusId.description: The unique identifier of the TaskStatus for this Task

priorityId.description: A numerical value representing the Priority of this Task

assignees[].description: A list of unique identifiers of TaskAssignees to be assigned to this Task

plannedStartDate.description: The date when work on this Task is planned to begin.

plannedFinishDate.description: The date when work on this Task is expected to complete.

plannedDuration.description: The planned duration (in minutes) for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

plannedEffort.description: The planned effort (in minutes) for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

plannedCost.description: The planned cost for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

actualStartDate.description: The date when work on this Task actually started, if known.

actualCost.description: The actual cost of this Task to date, if known.

theme.description:
Color theme definition for this task.
            
eg. Blue, Brown, DarkBlue, DarkGrey, Gold, Green, Grey, LightBrown, LightGreen,
LightGrey, LightPurple, LightYellow, Magenta, Mauve, Navy, Orange, Purple, Red.

isLocked.description:
Unlocked tasks can be adjusted by changes to their dependencies, resource leveling, or other factors.
            
All tasks are unlocked by default.
            
If a task is set to `IsLocked` = `true`, the dates and assigned resources are locked for this task and will not
be automatically changed by any process.

isMilestone.description:
True if this task is a milestone.  Milestones represent a specific point in time for the project.  When a
milestone is locked, it represents a fixed time within the project that can be used to relate to other tasks.

parentId.description:
Gets or sets the unique identifier of the parent task.
If set, this task will be a child of the specified parent task, supporting task hierarchies and sub-tasks.

index.description:
Gets or sets the position of the task within the list of project tasks.
Used to determine the order of tasks in the project with the first task being 1.

put.description: Updates an existing meeting in ProjectManager.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: The common name of this Task.

description.description:
This field contains the task's "Note" or "Description", which is a description of the work to be done to complete the task.
            
Within the ProjectManager application, you can use this field as follows:
* When in the Board or List view, click on a task to open the task panel, then edit the "Description" field.

priorityId.description: Return the priority of a task

plannedStartDate.description:
The date when work on this Task is planned to begin.
            
This value contains only the date in year-month-day format. For display, this
date will always be shown as this same year-month-day regardless of time zone.

durationMinutes.description: The duration (in 15-minute increments) for this Meeting.

assignees[].description: If specified, replaces the list of resources assigned to this meeting.

recurring.description:
Indicates whether this task participates in a recurring series.
true if the task is part of a recurrence (series parent when is, or a child otherwise);
false if it is a standalone task.
When saved as false during an update, the service layer detaches the task
from its series, which clears parent/child relationships including
and recurringSettings.

put.description: Updates an existing project in ProjectManager.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the Project to update

shortName.description: The short name of the Project.

description.description: An optional description of the Project

targetDate.description:
The target planned completion date for this Project, or null if one has
not been selected.  This value can be updated in the Project Settings
page or the Portfolio Project page within the application.

folderId.description:
To move this Project into a ProjectFolder, set this to the unique identifier of the
ProjectFolder.

customerId.description:
To assign this Project to a ProjectCustomer, set this to the unique identifier of the
ProjectCustomer.
            
If set to an empty guid the Project will be unassigned from the current ProjectCustomer.

managerId.description:
To assign this Project to a ProjectManager, set this to the unique identifier of the
ProjectManager.

chargeCodeId.description:
To set the ChargeCode for this Project, set this to the unique identifier of the
ChargeCode to use for this Project.

statusId.description:
To change the ProjectStatus of this Project, set this to the unique identifier of the
ProjectStatus.

priorityId.description:
To change the ProjectPriority of this Project, set this to the unique identifier of the
ProjectPriority.

hourlyRate.description: To change the hourly rate of this Project, set this to the new amount.

budget.description: To change the budget of this Project, set this to the new amount.

statusUpdate.description: To update the Project's status text, set this to the new status text.

favorite.description: Mark this project as favorite for the logged in user.

template.description:
True if this Project is a template that will be reused as a framework
for future Projects.
            
You can save a Project as a template and reuse it in the future for creating
additional Projects.  If this Project is a template, set this to `true` and this
template will be available to choose from when creating a new Project within the
application.

updatePlannedWithActual.description: True if allow actual dates to update planned dates

externalReferenceId.description:
An optional external reference identifier for this Project.
This value can be used to link the Project to records in external systems,
such as ERP, CRM, or other integrations.

The numerical percentage, from 0-100, representing the percentage completion
for this Task.  Any numbers below zero or above 100 will be clamped to the
minimum or maximum value.
            
This value can be edited manually in the Gantt chart view of the application,
or can be selected on the Task Detail page within the Kanban board.

statusId.description: The TaskStatus assigned to this Task.

plannedStartDate.description:
The date when work on this Task is planned to begin.
            
This value contains only the date in year-month-day format.  For display, this
date will always be shown as this same year-month-day regardless of time zone.
For reporting purposes, this date is calculated against the official time zone
of the Workspace.
            
For example: A Task has a planned completion date of July 5, 2023 in a Workspace
that has a time zone of US Pacific Time (GMT-7 or GMT-8, depending on daylight
savings time).  This project is considered overdue on 12:01 AM July 6th 2023 in
US Pacific time.

plannedFinishDate.description:

This value contains only the date in year-month-day format.  For display, this
date will always be shown as this same year-month-day regardless of time zone.
For reporting purposes, this date is calculated against the official time zone
of the Workspace.
            
For example: A Task has a planned completion date of July 5, 2023 in a Workspace
that has a time zone of US Pacific Time (GMT-7 or GMT-8, depending on daylight
savings time).  This project is considered overdue on 12:01 AM July 6th 2023 in
US Pacific time.

plannedDuration.description: The planned duration (in minutes) for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

plannedEffort.description: The planned effort (in minutes) for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

plannedCost.description: The planned cost for this Task.  Cannot be negative.

theme.description:

eg. Blue, Brown, DarkBlue, DarkGrey, Gold, Green, Grey, LightBrown, LightGreen,

isLocked.description:
Unlocked tasks can be adjusted by changes to their dependencies, resource leveling, or other factors.
            
All tasks are unlocked by default.
            
If a task is set to `IsLocked` = `true`, the dates and assigned resources are locked for this task and will not
be automatically changed by any process.

isMilestone.description:
True if this task is a milestone.  Milestones represent a specific point in time for the project.  When a
milestone is locked, it represents a fixed time within the project that can be used to relate to other tasks.
